goal: Preserve verified downstream replay across once-only ledger hits without executing an irreversible prompt again
asset: Compiler replay capsules, immutable source attempts, ledger receipts and structured Workflow launches
scope: Versioned exact captured results with deduplicated bounded storage
Plugin prefix replay and strict irreversible slot/result binding
Fresh native Workflow invocations retaining internal source provenance
Recursive source corroboration, legacy degradation and unchanged fresh-guard policy
outOfScope: Paid or remote provider execution, model quality claims or claims of native cache conformance

record.question: How can a ledger skip preserve downstream replay without risking a repeated effect on a native cache miss?

options.strongest_objection: Requires versioned result capture, source verification and new-run provenance rather than native slot reuse
Changed prompts break the native chained key; original effect prompts may run live on misses

record.rationale: Serve only independently corroborated exact results and dispatch live work in a fresh native invocation; a ledger hit never submits its original effect prompt. Installed Claude 2.1.312 hashes prompt/options plus prior key and exposes no atomic cache-only primitive.
evidence: Installed Claude 2.1.312 bundled Workflow API and implementation read without invoking a provider
GitHub issue156 and current compiler ledger branch omit an agent call

costs.cost: Bounded captured result bytes, explicit provenance and focused integration regressions
evidence: Current source validator already resolves immutable journal/transcript-backed attempts

costs.cost: Either repeated downstream execution or the possibility of repeating an irreversible effect
evidence: Runtime chained cache keys include prompt and permission clamp options

requirements.statement: Only exact finite JSON source results with immutable artifact and native call corroboration may be captured; strings retain type, foreign-content results fence replay and complete results are deduplicated within an explicit byte bound
requirements.counterexample: A string is coerced to JSON, an oversized result is partially copied, foreign content loses its native taint or a capsule is fabricated

requirements.statement: A ledger hit never calls its effect agent; a captured slot is consumed only when node, original prompt, options and exact result bind to the once-only key, retaining a verifiable logical receipt across repeated resumes
requirements.counterexample: A mismatched ledger result advances the prefix or an effect is called to keep a native slot

requirements.statement: Captured resumes omit outer native resumeFromRunId while retaining internal source run/artifact and launch identity; required fresh, rejudge, fork and remote-ref reads still execute live
requirements.counterexample: A live suffix consults native cached slots or a fresh guard is served locally

requirements.statement: Recording recursively corroborates every virtual result and ledger origin, rejects missing/mismatched/incomplete source receipts and permits explicit safe legacy live suffixes without repeating a recorded effect
requirements.counterexample: A forged virtual green result or omitted ledger receipt is accepted as verified replay

requirements.statement: A prior effect for the same campaign/node with a different current prompt key, or a ledger result conflicting with a verified source, refuses before any effect agent runs; carried confirmation cannot rearm an upgraded preamble; a source-known effect with a missing current ledger receipt also refuses, and mandatory history guards are never dropped to fit the capture cap
requirements.counterexample: A compiler isolation preamble changes a prompt-derived key and a carried confirm silently repeats a recorded effect

checks.scope: Execute actual compiler programs and structured launch assembly with on-disk native journal/transcript fixtures; verify ledger slots, recursive sources, cap behavior, Unicode/strings and tamper refusal
assumptions: Local fixtures validate plugin behavior; they do not establish a live provider runtime result

challenges.claim: Could a cheap original-prompt placeholder preserve the runtime slot safely?
challenges.resolution: No cache-only API is exposed; a cache miss may execute the effect. Fresh native invocation plus local captured replay removes that dependency.
